comparison: Full K2 + O psi + O F psi versus full K2 + O psi + F psi, same-rank Krylov, and rotations fixing the whole constant-coefficient space. Collective O is sum of the three nonuniform exchanges divided by sqrt(3); single modes are registered controls, not candidates for post-hoc selection.
coefficient_interpretation: Affine operator coefficient alpha+beta F. Report slopes only for full-column-rank fits and a fixed positive carrier-overlap phase; these coefficients are not probabilities or attention maps.
stopping_rule: No feature tuning, NN training, ED-target regression, or remote release in this diagnostic. Form O F before any A1 projection.
